name: NITROMURIATICUM ACIDUM
key_symptoms: Sour eructations, with empty hungry feeling in stomach; not relieved by eating. Salivation, worse at night.
guiding_symptoms: Sour eructations, with empty hungry feeling in stomach; not relieved by eating. Salivation, worse at night.
head_symptoms: Gums bleed easily. Ptyalism. Constant drooling at night (Merc). Cankers; small, superficial ulceration over inside of mouth and tongue. Metallic taste (Cupr met).
gi_symptoms: Sour eructations, with empty hungry feeling in stomach; not relieved by eating. Salivation, worse at night.

source.title: NITROMURIATICUM ACIDUM - HOMOEOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA - By William BOERICKE
